initialBuild.description:
## Savvy_Basics

Place points into Smart Efficiency, and then Active AFK'er. Excess points can be used to max Smart Efficiency.

## Mage

Place points into Logs on Logs and Deforesting All Doubt.
*15 If you have lots of leaves, some points may be played into Leaf Theif
